verdict.rationale: Orama is an open-source JS search library driven entirely through code (create a database from a schema, bulk `insertMultiple`), and Orama Cloud offers official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs, so headless programmatic use is implied. Nothing in the evidence explicitly documents CI or automation workflows. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage docs, a CLI for scripted index builds or deploys, CI pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
